photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 14:29:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1192 s; on-screen clock 05/03/13 14:29:50, wanted 14:29:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT-13 122 14:29:30-14:38' on 2013-05-02 (`as run matrix!B114`), read as 2013-05-02 14:29. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-05-02 plus one day, 14:29: it was found 1142 s into this video, and in no other video.
